{{AnimePokémonInfobox| trainername=Silver| pokemonname=Feraligatr| jtrainername=シルバー| jpokemonname=オーダイル| tmtrainername=Silver | tmpokemonname=Ordile | image=[[File:Silver Feraligatr.png|220px]] | caption=Silver's Feraligatr | location=[[New Bark Town]] | gender=Male | nature=Quiet | ability={{a|Torrent}} | type1=Water | media=special | catchepnum=PS093| catchepname=Sneasel Sneak Attack | evolution=2 | numeps1=7 | numeps2=50 | firststagename=Totodile | secondstagename=Croconaw | epnum=PS091 | epname=Murkrow Row | firstevoep=PS098 | firstevoname=Totodile Rock | prevonum=158 | evo1num=159 | evo2num=160 | secondevoep=PS148 | secondevoname=Lively Lugia (Part 3) | current=[[Party|With Silver]] | va=no | }} '''Silver's Feraligatr''' (Japanese: '''シルバーのオーダイル''' ''Silver's Ordile'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{adv|Silver}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his sixth overall. Silver acquired him by stealing him from [[Professor Elm]] while in [[Johto]]. As of ''[[PS454|All About Arceus III]]'', he is at [[level]] 83, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "thoroughly cunning." ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}=== [[File:Gold vs Silver Sprout Tower.png|thumb|200px|left|Totodile battling Exbo]] Feraligatr first appeared as a Totodile in ''[[PS091|Murkrow Row]]'' in [[Professor Elm]]'s lab, alongside [[Exbo|Cyndaquil]] and [[Megaree|Chikorita]]. [[PS093|Later]], when {{adv|Gold}} and {{adv|Silver}} snuck into Elm's Lab, Silver stole Totodile due to a mission he received from [[Lance]]. After escaping the lab Totodile battles against a group of [[Team Rocket]] grunts. Despite a type disadvantage, Totodile is able to defeat the grunt's {{p|Elekid}}, as Silver taught him {{m|Frustration}} right before the battle. In ''[[PS098|Totodile Rock]]'', Totodile fought against Exbo in the [[Sprout Tower]]. The two start out with {{m|Tackle}} and {{m|Scratch}} and follow up with {{m|Ember}} and {{m|Water Gun}}, giving Totodile the lead. Due to this Exbo counters with {{m|Smokescreen}} and gives Gold a chance to take Totodile back, but he refuses and {{m|Bite|bites}} him. The smoke soon sets off an alarm in the tower and activates its traps, forcing the two Pokémon to team up and stop them. In the confusion Silver escapes and Totodile [[Evolution|evolves]] into {{p|Croconaw}}. In ''[[PS111|Tyranitar War]]'', Croconaw was Silver's first choice in his battle against Gold and fought against Exbo again. Croconaw starts by drenching Exbo with Water Gun and biting down on him with Bite. Exbo manages to dodge the attack with {{m|Double Team}}, breaking Croconaw's teeth. Croconaw recovers though and throws Exbo away. [[File:Silver and Feraligatr.png|thumb|200px|Feraligatr and Silver]] In ''[[PS147|Lively Lugia (Part 2)]]'', Croconaw meets back up with Exbo and Megaree and fought against a wild {{DL|Tower duo (Adventures)|Lugia}} at the [[Whirl Islands]]. When Lugia attempts to crush them under its weight, Croconaw, Exbo, and Megaree work together to hold Lugia up. The strain of this causes Croconaw, Exbo, and Megaree to evolve into {{p|Feraligatr}}, {{p|Typhlosion}}, and {{p|Meganium}}, respectively. Though they succeed in saving their Trainers, Lugia eventually escapes. In ''[[PS177|The Last Battle XI]]'', Feraligatr battled alongside Silver's other Pokémon to defeat [[Will]] by attacking with {{TP|Silver|Sneasel}}'s {{m|Beat Up}}. In ''[[PS180|The Last Battle XIV]]'', he is used alongside the other [[first partner Pokémon]] to try and stop [[Pryce]] from capturing {{adv|Celebi}}. ==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}=== In ''[[PS301|Storming the Forretress]]'', after {{adv|Giovanni}} was defeated and [[Carr]] sent the [[Team Rocket airship]] containing him, Silver, his loyal subordinates, and their enemies crashing, Feraligatr teamed up with the other {{type|Water}} Pokémon to try to keep the airship in place. However, ultimately, it was {{adv|Mew}} who saved it. After this, he was petrified alongside his {{pkmn|Trainer}}. ==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}=== [[File:First partners Ultimate Attacks Adventures.png|thumb|left|250px|Defeating the fake Kyogre]] In ''[[PS334|The Final Battle VII]]'', Feraligatr becomes unpetrified and regained mobility and quickly starts battling [[Guile Hideout]]'s stolen {{gdis|Battle Tower|III}} Pokémon. Due to Silver being conscious while frozen and having [[Ultima]]'s bracelet on he managed to pick up the skills required to teach Feraligatr {{m|Hydro Cannon}}, and thus was the fastest of the [[Pokédex holder]]s to learn it. In ''[[PS335|The Final Battle VIII]]'', Feraligatr, [[Blasty]], and [[Mumu]] attack with Hydro Cannon to help destroy Guile Hideout's fake {{p|Kyogre}}. ==={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}=== In ''[[PS445|Dealing With A Koffing Fit]]'', Silver arrives at Lance's [[Whirl Islands|secret hideout]] and is soon attacked by a group of [[Petrel]]'s {{p|Koffing}}. Feraligatr fought alongside the rest of Silver's team to drive off the large horde of the Poison Gas Pokémon. In ''[[PS456|All About Arceus V]]'', Feraligatr teams up with Exbo and Megaree to use their {{m|Blast Burn|ultimate}} {{m|Frenzy Plant|attacks}} against the incomplete forms of {{adv|Pokémon of myth|Dialga, Palkia, and Giratina}}. While the attack managed to slow them down it ended up failing. ==Personality and characteristics== Since Feraligatr debuted, he has been shown to be a competitive Pokémon. He appears to care very much about {{adv|Silver}}, to the point of not responding to {{adv|Gold}} and [[Exbo]]'s plea to come back to them, even though he had only been with Silver a short time. This is further expressed when his most powerful [[friendship]]-related attack changes from {{m|Frustration}} to {{m|Return}} to highlight his trust and loyalty toward his {{pkmn|Trainer}}. ==Appearance== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{water color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{water color dark}}" |- !
